text: 43 May I play with you? No, No... Only two of us want to play. Nobody is ready to play with Suyog. So he decided to play alone. Suyog is building a sand castle. Now everyone wants to join him. Hey, look at this. Oh, a sand castle! Shall we join him? Can we play with you? Let me build a castle. They all play happily together. Yes, of course you can. What did you learn from this story? Togetherness gives happiness. Shreya and Rohan are playing hopscotch. Suyog wants to join them. 2. Enact the story. 3. Discuss why Suyog could make friends?
